# 1748. Sum of Unique Elements

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def sumOfUnique(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        d = collections.Counter(nums)
        ans = 0
        for k, v in d.items():
            if v == 1:
                ans += k
        return ans
```
